title: Hazel and the Will
author: R. M. Fairweather
blurb: Sebastian Crane, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
